info.description: Backend API for AGEM wearable users, devices, qring sensor data, sleep, and workouts.
info.title: AGEM Backend API

post.description: Creates a wearable device registry record.

get.description: Returns one device by stable wearable UID or MAC address.
Lists device-local daily activity summaries in an inclusive date range.

post.description: Creates or updates one device-local daily activity summary for a device.

get.description: Lists device events in an RFC3339 time range, optionally filtered by event type.

post.description: Idempotently ingests device events such as sync markers, battery state, binding events, or SDK notifications.

get.description: Lists health metric points in an RFC3339 time range, optionally filtered by metric name.

post.description: Idempotently ingests qring health metric points such as heart rate, SpO2, stress, HRV, and temperature.

get.description: Lists sleep stage segments by device-local sleep date.

post.description: Idempotently ingests sleep stage segments for a device.

get.description: Returns a sleep summary by device-local sleep date.

post.description: Creates or updates one device-local sleep summary for a device and sleep date.

get.description: Aggregates daily step totals from the steps_15m time series collection.
Lists 15-minute step points by device-local date.

post.description: Idempotently ingests 15-minute qring step detail points.

get.description: Lists workouts in an RFC3339 time range.

post.description: Creates or replaces a workout keyed by device ID and start_utc.

delete.description: Deletes a workout identified by device ID and start_utc query parameter.

patch.description: Updates a workout identified by device ID and start_utc in the request body.

get.description: Returns one device by API ID.

delete.description: Deletes a device by API ID.

patch.description: Updates device metadata and last seen timestamp.
Updates pairing nickname, primary flag, or unpaired time.

post.description: Creates an AGEM user identity record.

get.description: Returns one AGEM user by ID.
Lists device pairings for one user.

post.description: Creates a pairing record between a user and a device.

get.description: Returns QRing-style daily wearable snapshots grouped by devices paired to the user.

parameters.description: Include raw readings and sleep segments in snapshot payloads
parameters.name: include_readings

get.description: Returns QRing-style daily wearable snapshots in an inclusive device-local date range.

parameters.description: Include raw readings and sleep segments in snapshot payloads
parameters.name: include_readings

post.description: Stores a QRing-style daily wearable payload, preserves the snapshot, and fans out recognized sections into MongoDB collections.
